snapshot_defect_sharpened.reader_needs: minute % 5 == 0 (cycle-bootstrap SKILL.md Step -1 rounds to nearest 5-min slot)
snapshot_defect_sharpened.promoter_needs: minute in {00,15,30,45} (telemetry.md Step 6 looks up by NOMINAL quarter tick)
snapshot_defect_sharpened.this_tick_evidence: writer emitted cycle-snapshot-04:20.json at 04:20:40Z. 04:20 SATISFIES the reader. It FAILS the promoter, which looked for cycle-snapshot-04:15.json (nominal tick) — confirmed absent on disk — hence cycle_snapshot_promoted:false even on a 'good' name.
snapshot_defect_sharpened.why_promoter_is_0_of_46_structurally: Step 4.7 stamps date -u +%H:%M at the moment it runs, which is nominal_tick + drift + preflight + drain + claim latency. That delay is essentially never zero, so the raw minute essentially never equals the quarter-tick minute. 0/46 is the expected value, not bad luck.
